changelog:
Initial release of Reflection Weaver

- Transforms reflections, draft essays, or voice-note transcripts into linked knowledge objects.
- Preserves the original writing and authorial voice while extracting only stable, reusable concepts.
- Weaves natural, meaningful links into the text body and strengthens backlinks for rediscovery.
- Clearly splits drafts serving multiple roles into appropriate note types (reflection, concept, synthesis).
- Ensures extracted concepts are substantial (mechanisms, patterns, tensions) and avoids overlinking or overgeneralizing.
